correctness.rationale: The exact difference F_i−F_j=[r−η product_{l≠i,j}p_l](p_i−p_j) contracts by q=max(r,1−r)<1 for 0<µ<1, η≤1, and all n≥3. On the symmetric diagonal, each active step multiplies x by G(x)=r+ηx^{n−2}(1−x)≤r+ηm_n; products over k activations and ka silent steps imply η≥(r^(−a)−r)/m_n. Equality forces every pre-pulse value x* and every integer gap a, proving strict schedule uniqueness. Scalar compact strict contraction away from equality plus transverse synchronization yields extinction; uniform schedule H(x) has two nonzero fixed roots above threshold and a fold at equality, with longitudinal/transverse multipliers given in proof. Independently reproduced η*=38/45, nonuniform return 8081/16200, and n=7/8 group-size cutoff for µ=.01,a=2,η=.5.
